profile.description: Cris-Tim Family Holding S.A. engages in the processing and distribution of meat, meat products, and other food products in Romania. It operates in two segments, Cold Cuts and Ready Meals. The Cold Cuts segment offers cooked and smoked sausages, hams, salamis, bacon, spreads, and specialty meats under the Cris-Tim, Matache Macelaru, and Alpinia brands. Its Ready Meals segment provides ready meals, such as sarmale and meatballs; cooked meat components and sides; and salads and deli-style spreads under the Bunata?i brand. The company also exports its products. It distributes its products through hypermarkets, supermarkets, discounters, and cash-and-carry stores, as well as independent retail stores and wholesale outlets. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Bucharest, Romania. Cris-Tim Family Holding S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Rangeglow Limited.
